app.name: Shift Planner
app.tagline: Plan next month's shifts in minutes.

stepDescriptions.store: Opening hours, special dates and how many people you need.
stepDescriptions.employees: Your team, their contracts and hour balances.
stepDescriptions.availability: When people can't work, and when they'd prefer to.
stepDescriptions.generate: Let the planner find the best schedule.
stepDescriptions.plan: Review and fine-tune the schedule by hand.
stepDescriptions.export: Print it or open it in a spreadsheet.
stepDescriptions.advanced: Every rule and weight. Optional – the defaults work well.

empty.comingSoonBody: This step is part of an upcoming release.

project.newDescription: Choose the month you want to plan.
project.replaceDescription: Your current plan will be replaced. Save it first if you want to keep a copy.

welcome.title: Plan next month's shifts
welcome.subtitle: Enter your opening hours, your team and their wishes. Shift Planner finds a plan that follows the rules, and you can fine-tune it by hand.
welcome.newDescription: Begin with sensible defaults for the month you choose.
welcome.demoDescription: A fictional team of 9 people with availability and wishes, ready to plan.
welcome.openDescription: Continue from a .json file you saved earlier.
welcome.privacy: Your data stays in this browser. The server only uses it to calculate the plan and stores nothing.

errors.offline: Can't reach the planning service. Check that it is running and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.fileNotJson: This file isn't a Shift Planner project.
errors.restoreFailed: Your autosaved plan couldn't be restored. A backup copy was kept in this browser.

project.missingSchemaVersion: This file isn't a Shift Planner project (no format version found).
project.newerSchemaVersion: This file was saved by a newer version of Shift Planner (format {{version}}; this app supports up to {{supported}}).
project.noMigration: This file uses format {{version}}, which can't be upgraded automatically.
project.invalid_one: This project file has {{count}} problem and can't be opened.
project.invalid_other: This project file has {{count}} problems and can't be opened.

store.name: Store name
store.hoursDescription: When customers can shop. Staff are planned from before opening until after closing.
store.closesBeforeOpens: Closing time must be after opening time.
store.beforeHelp: Minutes of work before the doors open.
store.afterHelp: Minutes of work after the doors close.
store.specialDescription: Public holidays use the holiday hours. Turn on special hours to close early, open late, or close for the day.
store.noSpecialDates: No public holidays this month. Add a date below to give it special hours.
store.staffingDescription: The minimum number of people at the start and end of each day. The planner takes care of the rest.
store.allowAloneHelp: When off, at least 2 people are present whenever the store is staffed.
store.dailyHelp: Opening and closing count from when staff arrive and leave. Daily hours are optional; leave them empty for no target.
store.rangesDescription: Extra minimums for part of the day, e.g. at least 2 people 11:00–14:00 on Saturdays.
store.rangeInvalid: Pick at least one day type, and an end time after the start time.
store.dailyHardHelp: Off: the planner aims for the daily hours but may go outside them when needed. On: never planned outside them, which can make a month impossible to plan.

maxHoursPerDay.label: Max hours per day
maxHoursPerDay.help: Total of all shifts on one day. Empty = same as the maximum shift length.

minRestHours.label: Minimum rest between shifts
minRestHours.help: Time off between the end of one shift and the start of the next (Danish law: 11 h).

maxConsecutiveDays.label: Max days in a row
maxConsecutiveDays.help: Working days in a row before a day off (Danish law: at most 6).

maxWeeklyHours.label: Max hours per week
maxWeeklyHours.help: Hard limit for any calendar week.

granularityMin.label: Time grid for suggested shifts
granularityMin.help: Generated shifts start and end on this grid. You can still use any minute when editing by hand.

oneShiftPerDay.label: At most one shift per day
oneShiftPerDay.help: When off, a person can have a split shift.

fullTimeThresholdHours.label: Full-time from
fullTimeThresholdHours.help: People with at least this many contract hours per week count as full-time.

fullTimeContractWarning.label: Warn when a full-timer works above contract in a week
fullTimeContractWarning.help: A warning only. The weekly maximum above is the hard limit.

holidaysReduceTarget.label: Public holidays reduce the target
holidaysReduceTarget.help: Each public holiday on a weekday reduces the target by a fifth of a week. Off, because the store is open on holidays.

balancingPeriodWeeks.label: Balancing period (weeks)
balancingPeriodWeeks.help: Hours are averaged over this period. The Danish retail agreement uses 16 weeks for part-timers.

monthlyToleranceHours.label: Monthly tolerance (±)
monthlyToleranceHours.help: Deviation from the hour-balance goal that's fine this month. Beyond it the planner tries much harder.

monthlyHardLimitHours.label: Hard limit (±)
monthlyHardLimitHours.help: Optional. Never plan anyone further than this from their monthly target.

teamAdjustmentHours.label: Team adjustment
teamAdjustmentHours.help: Shift the whole team's target this month, e.g. −10 h after a month with too many hours. Spread by contract hours.

enabled.label: Ride rule for early shifts
enabled.help: Someone who needs a ride and starts before the cutoff must start at exactly the same time as someone allowed to drive them.

earlyCutoff.label: First bus
earlyCutoff.help: Shifts starting at or after this time are fine, because the bus runs.

lateEnabled.label: Ride rule for late shifts
lateEnabled.help: Off by default. Someone who needs a ride home and ends after the cutoff must end together with a driver.

lateCutoff.label: Last bus
lateCutoff.help: Shifts ending at or before this time are fine.

enabled.label: Include breaks
enabled.help: Long shifts include a break of the given length.

paid.label: Breaks are paid
paid.help: When off, break time doesn't count as worked hours.

employees.emptyBody: Add the people you plan for. You'll set their contract hours, transport and hour balance.
employees.name: Name
employees.activeHelp: Inactive people stay in the project but aren't planned this month.
employees.hasCarHelp: Can drive colleagues to early or late shifts.
employees.needsRideEarly: Needs a ride to early shifts
employees.needsRideEarlyHelp: Before the first bus, this person must start at exactly the same time as a driver.
employees.needsRideLate: Needs a ride home from late shifts
employees.needsRideLateHelp: After the last bus, this person must finish at exactly the same time as a driver.
employees.needsRideLateOff: Only used if the late-evening ride rule is turned on in Advanced settings.
employees.noDrivers: Nobody else has a car yet.
employees.balanceHelp: The app doesn't remember past months, so enter where this person stands today.
employees.carryInHelp: Hours above (+) or below (−) target so far in the balancing period.
employees.periodWeekHelp: Which of the {{weeks}} weeks this month starts in. The planner evens out the balance harder near the end.
employees.lastShiftEndedHelp: Optional. Ensures enough rest before their first shift this month.
employees.daysInARow: Days worked in a row at month start
employees.daysInARowHelp: Optional. Counts toward the days-in-a-row limit at the start of the month.
employees.limitsHelp: Override the store-wide rules for this person. Leave empty to use the store-wide value.
employees.deleteDescription: Their availability, wishes and shifts in this project are removed too.

availability.hint: Click a day to add or remove; drag across days for a range, like a vacation.
availability.hardExplained: Unavailable is a hard rule: the planner never schedules over it.
availability.wishExplained: Wishes are soft: the planner tries to honour them, and there's no limit on how many.
availability.emptyList: Nothing yet. Click days in the calendar, or add a recurring rule like "Mondays after 16:00".
availability.noEmployeesBody: Add people in the Employees step first.
availability.addDescription: Use this for recurring weekdays and part-day times. Whole days are quicker to click in the calendar.
availability.partOfDayHelp: Leave one time empty for "from 16:00" or "until 12:00".
availability.windowInvalid: Enter at least one time, and an end after the start.

advanced.resetDescription: Every setting on this page goes back to its default. Your store, team and availability are not affected.
advanced.shiftsDescription: Length and spacing of the shifts the planner suggests.
advanced.workingTimeDescription: Legal and contractual limits per person.
advanced.balanceDescription: How contract hours become a monthly target, and how the balance is evened out.
advanced.busTitle: Rides to early and late shifts
advanced.busDescription: For people who can't take the bus at the start or end of the day.
advanced.breaksDescription: Off by default. When on, long shifts include a break.
advanced.weightsDescription: How much each soft goal matters relative to the others. Higher means more important.
advanced.guestsDescription: Turn expected guests per day into the day's total staff hours.
advanced.solverDescription: How long the planner may search for the best plan.

wishOff.label: Day-off wishes
wishOff.help: Penalty for planning someone who asked for time off.

wishWork.label: Work wishes
wishWork.help: Reward for planning someone who asked to work.

hourBalance.label: Hour balance
hourBalance.help: Steer everyone's balance toward zero. Stronger near the end of the balancing period.

beyondTolerance.label: Beyond tolerance
beyondTolerance.help: Extra penalty per hour outside the monthly tolerance.

dailyTarget.label: Daily hour targets
dailyTarget.help: Penalty for missing the daily hour targets on the Store step.

contiguousDaysOff.label: Days off together
contiguousDaysOff.help: A subtle tie-breaker that prefers days off next to each other.

enabled.label: Use guest-based demand
enabled.help: Arrives in a later release. You can already prepare the conversion table.

tolerance.label: Tolerance (±)
tolerance.help: How far the day's total may differ from the target.

timeLimit.label: Time limit
timeLimit.help: The planner returns the best plan found within this time. 20 seconds is usually plenty.

generate.title: Plan {{month}}
generate.searchingHelp: The planner keeps improving the plan until the time limit. You can change the limit in Advanced settings.

status.infeasible: No plan follows all the rules
status.best_effort: No plan follows every rule. Here's the closest one

generate.summary: {{shifts}} shifts · {{honoured}} of {{wishes}} wish days honoured · {{seconds}} s
generate.infeasibleHelp: Some hard rules can't all be met this month. Check unavailability, staffing needs and limits. Detailed explanations are coming in a later release.
generate.timeoutHelp: The planner couldn't find a plan within {{seconds}} s. Try a longer time limit in Advanced settings.
generate.issuesDescription: Rules the plan breaks (red) and warnings (amber).
generate.precheckOk: No problems found in the setup.
generate.precheckErrors: No plan can follow every rule as things are set up. You can still generate: you'll get the closest possible plan, with the broken rules marked.
generate.diagnosticsTitle: Why the rules can't all be met
generate.bestEffortSummary_one: {{count}} rule is broken; see the list below. {{shifts}} shifts · {{seconds}} s
generate.bestEffortSummary_other: {{count}} rules are broken; see the list below. {{shifts}} shifts · {{seconds}} s

violation.inactive_employee: {{name}} is inactive but has a shift on {{date}}.
violation.store_closed: {{name}} has a shift on {{date}}, but the store is closed.
violation.outside_opening_hours: {{name}}'s shift on {{date}} ({{start}}–{{end}}) is outside the staffed hours ({{windowStart}}–{{windowEnd}}).
violation.shift_too_short: {{name}}'s shift on {{date}} is shorter than {{min}} h.
violation.shift_too_long: {{name}}'s shift on {{date}} is longer than {{max}} h.
violation.too_many_shifts: {{name}} has more than one shift on {{date}}.
violation.rest_too_short: {{name}} only rests {{rest}} h before the shift on {{date}} (minimum {{min}} h).
violation.too_many_days_in_a_row: {{name}} works more than {{max}} days in a row, on {{date}}.
violation.weekly_hours_exceeded: {{name}} works {{planned}} h in the week of {{date}} (maximum {{max}} h).
violation.weekly_above_contract: {{name}} works {{planned}} h in the week of {{date}}, above the {{contract}} h contract.
violation.unavailable: {{name}} is unavailable on {{date}} {{start}}–{{end}} but has a shift.
violation.busy_period_understaffed: {{date}} {{start}}–{{end}}: too few people for the busy period (needed: {{required}}, missing: {{missing}}).
violation.daily_hours_below_min: {{date}}: {{planned}} h planned, below the daily target of {{min}} h.
violation.daily_hours_above_max: {{date}}: {{planned}} h planned, above the daily target of {{max}} h.
violation.no_ride_early: {{name}} starts at {{start}} on {{date}}, before the first bus ({{cutoff}}), without a driver.
violation.no_ride_late: {{name}} finishes at {{end}} on {{date}}, after the last bus ({{cutoff}}), without a driver.
violation.monthly_limit_exceeded: {{name}} is {{deviation}} h from the monthly target (limit ±{{limit}} h).

diagnostic.no_employees: There's nobody to plan yet. Add people on the Employees step.
diagnostic.opening_short: {{date}}: too few people available at opening, {{time}} (available: {{available}}, needed: {{required}}).
diagnostic.closing_short: {{date}}: too few people available until closing, {{time}} (available: {{available}}, needed: {{required}}).
diagnostic.moment_short: {{date}}: too few people available at {{time}} (available: {{available}}, needed: {{required}}).
diagnostic.busy_period_short: {{date}}: too few people available for the busy period at {{time}} (available: {{available}}, needed: {{required}}).
diagnostic.day_short_of_people: {{date}}: too few people can work to cover the whole day (available: {{available}}, needed: {{required}}).
diagnostic.window_shorter_than_min_shift: {{date}}: staff are only needed {{start}}–{{end}}, which is shorter than the minimum shift of {{min}} h.
diagnostic.not_enough_working_days: The month needs at least {{required}} working days in total, but the team can work at most {{available}} (days-in-a-row limit and absences).
diagnostic.hours_below_demand: The team's contracts add up to {{contract}} h this month, but staffing the store needs at least {{demand}} h.
diagnostic.hours_above_demand: The team's contracts add up to {{contract}} h this month, far more than the {{demand}} h the store needs at minimum.
diagnostic.rider_without_driver: {{names}} needs a ride but nobody is allowed to drive them, so they can never start before the first bus.
diagnostic.no_driver_early: {{date}}: no driver is available before {{cutoff}}, so {{names}} can't start early.

solver.timeout: No plan was found within {{seconds}} s.

diagnostic.unknown: The planner reported a problem with this month.
